areaGuide.title: Living in Putrajaya – Complete Guide to Room Rental & Property Rental in Malaysia's Administrative Capital
areaGuide.description: Putrajaya is one of Malaysia's most organised and peaceful cities, making it a popular destination for room rental, condo rental and apartment rental. The area attracts government employees, professionals, families, expatriates, students and workers from nearby Cyberjaya who are looking for affordable and comfortable accommodation. Whether you are searching for a master room for rent in Putrajaya, a furnished room near government offices, a condo rental near IOI City Mall, a studio apartment, a family apartment or a budget-friendly room rental, Putrajaya offers a wide range of housing options. Residents enjoy modern infrastructure, beautiful landscapes, Putrajaya Lake, excellent highways, shopping malls, schools, recreational facilities and easy access to Cyberjaya, Kuala Lumpur and Kuala Lumpur International Airport, making Putrajaya one of the best places to rent property in Malaysia.
